question: The extra time needed to bring the data into memory in case of a miss is called as __________
explanation: None.

question: The miss penalty can be reduced by improving the mechanisms for data transfer between the different levels of hierarchy.
explanation: The extra time needed to bring the data into memory in case of a miss is called as miss penalty.

question: The completion of the memory operation is indicated using ______ signal.
explanation: MFC stands for Memory Function Complete.

question: _________ signal enables the processor to wait for the memory operation to complete.
explanation: This signal stands for Wait For Memory Function Complete.

question: The small extremely fast RAM is called as ________
explanation: A cache speeds up the execution of a program significantly, by keeping a copy of data and instructions locally in the CPU.

question: The main virtue for using a single Bus structure is ________
options: C) Cost-effective connectivity and ease of attaching peripheral devices
explanation: The advantage of single bus architecture is the simplicity of the design wherein all the components will fit on the same bus and hence it’s cost-effective. It may not be very fast though.

question: To extend the connectivity of the processor bus we use ______
explanation: The PCI bus is generally the system bus on the motherboard and it is used to connect the CPU, Memory, and peripheral devices using other buses or channels or controllers.

question: The bus used to connect the monitor to the CPU is ____________
explanation: PCI bus connects CPU to the Display Unit whereas SCSI bus is used to connect to storage devices.

question: The IDE bus is used to connect ___________
options: C) Both Harddisk and CD/DVD drives and Processor
D) Only CD/DVD drives and Processor
explanation: IDE bus is used to connect to peripheral devices like hard disks and CD/DVD drives using master-slave mode.

question: ANSI stands for _____________
explanation: American National Standards Institute or ANSI is one of the prime organizations in the US which works towards the standardization of various Technologies in Computer-Sciences and other technology fields.

question: IBM developed a bus standard for their line of computers ‘PC-AT’ called ________
explanation: “Industry Standard Architecture” or ISA bus was designed by IBM way back in the days of 8-bit or 16-bit computing platforms as a bus for Personal Computers.

question: The general purpose registers are combined into a block called as ______
explanation: To make the access of the registers easier, we classify them into register files.

question: In ______ technology, the implementation of the register file is by using an array of memory locations.
explanation: By doing so the access of the registers can be made faster.

question: In a three BUS architecture, how many input and output ports are there?
explanation: That is enabling reading from two locations and writing into one.

question: The main advantage of multiple bus organisation over a single bus is __________
options: A) Reduction in the number of cycles for execution
B) Increase in size of the registers
explanation: None.

question: CISC stands for _________
explanation: The CISC machines are well adept at handling multiple BUS organisation.

question: If the instruction Add R1, R2, R3 is executed in a system which is pipelined, then the value of S is (Where S is term of the Basic performance equation).
explanation: The value will be much lower in case of multiple BUS organisation.

question: In multiple BUS organisation __________ is used to select any of the BUSes for input into ALU.
explanation: The MUX can be used to either select the BUS or to increment the PC.

question: There exists a separate block consisting of various units to decode an instruction.
explanation: This block is used to decode the instruction and place it in the IR.

question: There exists a separate block to increment the PC in multiple BUS organisation.
explanation: None.

question: The physical memory is not as large as the address space spanned by the processor.
explanation: This is one of the main reasons for the usage of virtual memories.

question: The program is divided into operable parts called as _________
explanation: The program is divided into parts called as segments for ease of execution.

question: The techniques which move the program blocks to or from the physical memory is called as ______
explanation: By using this technique the program execution is accomplished with a usage of less space.

question: The binary address issued to data or instructions are called as ______
explanation: The logical address is the random address generated by the processor.

question: __________ is used to implement virtual memory organisation.
explanation: The MMU stands for Memory Management Unit.

question: ______ translates the logical address into a physical address.
explanation: The MMU translates the logical address into a physical address by adding an offset.

question: The main aim of virtual memory organisation is ________
options: A) To provide effective memory access
B) To provide better memory transfer
C) To improve the execution of the program
explanation: None.

question: The DMA doesn’t make use of the MMU for bulk data transfers.
explanation: The DMA stands for Direct Memory Access, in which a block of data gets directly transferred from the memory.

question: The virtual memory basically stores the next segment of data to be executed on the _________
explanation: None.

question: The associatively mapped virtual memory makes use of _______
explanation: TLB stands for Translation Look-aside Buffer.

question: The disk system consists of which of the following?
explanation: None.

question: The set of corresponding tracks on all surfaces of a stack of disks form a ______
explanation: The data is stored in these sections called as cylinders.

question: The data can be accessed from the disk using _________
explanation: None.

question: The read and write operations usually start at ______ of the sector.
options: C) From the last used point
explanation: The heads read and write data from the ends to the center.

question: To distinguish between two sectors we make use of ________
explanation: This means that we leave a little gap between each sector to differentiate between them.

question: The _____ process divides the disk into sectors and tracks.
explanation: The formatting process deletes the data present and does the creation of sectors and tracks.

question: The access time is composed of __________
options: D) Both Seek time and Rotational delay
explanation: The seek time refers to the time required to move the head to the required disk.

question: The disk drive is connected to the system by using the _____
explanation: None.

question: _______ is used to deal with the difference in the transfer rates between the drive and the bus.
explanation: The buffers are added to store the data from the fast device and to send it to the slower device at its rate.

question: _______ is used to detect and correct the errors that may occur during data transfers.
explanation: ECC stands for Error Correcting Code.

question: The product of 1101 & 1011 is ______
explanation: The above operation is performed using binary multiplication.

question: We make use of ______ circuits to implement multiplication.
explanation: The fast adders are used to add the multiplied numbers.

question: The multiplier is stored in ______
explanation: The value is stored in a shift register so that each bit can be accessed separately.

question: The ______ is used to coordinate the operation of the multiplier.
explanation: This performs the required sequencing of the various parts of the circuit.

question: The multiplicand and the control signals are passed through to the n-bit adder via _____
explanation: None.

question: The product of -13 & 11 is ______________
explanation: None.

question: The method used to reduce the maximum number of summands by half is _______
explanation: It reduces the number of summands by concatenating them.

question: The bits 1 & 1 are recorded as _______ in bit-pair recording.
explanation: Its ‘-1’  when the previous bit is 0 and ‘0’ when the previous bit is 1.

question: The multiplier -6(11010) is recorded as _______
explanation: None.

question: CSA stands for?
explanation: The CSA is used to speed up the addition of multiplicands.
